_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Bernard Guilbert Guerney (1894-1979): Kuprin's Yama (The Pit, 1922) and Sulamith (1923), and Bunin's The Dreams of Chang (Knopf, 1923). Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 29); Adam may veto. No uids minted. From archive.org (2026-10-23): Kuprin's Gambrinus and Other Stories (Adelphi, 1925), Merejkovski's The Menace of the Mob (Brown, 1921) and The Death of the Gods (Modern Library, 1929). Herbert Trench's older translations of Merezhkovsky are on herbert-trench.
